title: unify-sdks-auth-retries-streaming-parity-ergonomics-v1.104.0
author: Devon Chen
description: Unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs and bump SDK package versions to v1.104.0. Motivation: customers see inconsistent retry/backoff behavior and streaming ergonomics between SDKs which causes duplicated server-side retries and poor reconnect UX. This PR implements a single, tested retry policy (idempotency-aware, exponential backoff with full jitter, pluggable per-client and per-call overrides), standardized token refresh hooks for auth providers, and streaming parity fixes (stable chunked frames, deterministic reconnect/resume tokens, backpressure-friendly streaming iterator/async iterable ergonomics). Changes are grouped by SDK but share a single implementation in /sdks/shared/retries and /sdks/shared/streaming to limit drift. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked in Linear ENG-4321 - [x] unify retry implementation and expose default policy - [x] add token refresh hook and example for OAuth/KMS-based rotation - [x] streaming resume token test harness and e2e tests - [x] update Python, TS, Go public surfaces for ergonomic iteration - [x] bump package versions (python 1.104.0, ts 1.104.0, go 1.104.0) - [x] add integration tests against local canary runtime - [x] update changelogs and migration notes. No breaking changes for common flows; a small optional rename on the TS client for a streaming helper (stream.toAsyncIterator -> stream.asyncIterator) is included but the old alias is retained for a deprecation cycle. See release_notes for migration steps.

release_notes: SDKs: v1.104.0 release unifies retry and streaming behavior across Python/TS/Go. Key user-facing changes: default retry policy standardized (idempotent-method aware), token_refresh callback for auth rotation, more reliable streaming resume tokens and improved streaming iteration ergonomics. Migration: update to new package versions, optionally update TypeScript streaming helper name (old alias retained). See docs/changelogs/sdk-v1.104.0.md for detailed steps.
